title: YouCoded — round 10: the logo set in Outfit, the K4 family, glass box installers

steps.path: Everywhere the name, icon or "yc" appears
steps.headline: Are these the right lockups: horizontal, with tagline, stacked, name alone, and "yc"?
steps.changed: Six fixed arrangements of the icon, the lowercase name in Outfit SemiBold, the tagline and the initials, so every surface uses one of these instead of improvising.
steps.notice: Picking the icon later only swaps the picture; the arrangements stay.
steps.risk: "Name alone" relies on the icon being visible somewhere else on the same screen.

steps.path: Everywhere the name, icon or "yc" appears
steps.headline: Are these the right colour versions: light, dark, over a theme picture, one-colour, and following the theme?
steps.changed: "you" in the mascot's glass gradient and "coded" in ink on light; white on dark; white glass over pictures; single-colour versions for print; and the gradient taking each theme's colours.
steps.notice: The app already changes its icon per theme; the name could follow the same way.
steps.risk: Over very busy pictures only the white glass version stays readable.

steps.path: Everywhere the name, icon or "yc" appears
steps.headline: Are these the right rules for spacing, sizes, colours, type and don'ts?
steps.changed: Clear space of half the icon's height around the logo, smallest sizes, the four colours with exact codes, Outfit SemiBold lowercase, "YouCoded" in sentences, and four don'ts.
steps.notice: This is the sheet anyone (you, a contributor, a future session) follows to put the logo somewhere new.
steps.risk: Writing "YouCoded" in sentences but "youcoded" in the logo is a deliberate split; say so if you'd rather the name be lowercase everywhere.

steps.path: Everywhere the name, icon or "yc" appears
steps.headline: Does the set work in use: site header and hero, app title bar, browser tab, help pages, footer?
steps.changed: The same lockups from L1 placed on the real surfaces, including "yc" + section name for help and docs pages.
steps.notice: Help pages use the plain ink initials so they read calm and clinical.
steps.risk: The app title bar version is small (14px name); it's at the edge of readable on high-resolution screens.

steps.path: Taskbar, dock, browser tab, the lockups
steps.headline: Which of K4's family do you like? Pick as many as you want.
steps.notice: All keep K4's milk-glass face panel and eyes; each changes one thing — expression, pose, material or setting.
